reuse.why: expectedAmount is computed by the existing shared getScheduledAmount, which already encodes the missing/number/range rule used elsewhere.

duplication.why: No logic is copied; the rule stays in one helper.

placement.why: The field is added in scheduleModel.toExternal, the tree's internal-to-API mapping layer, with a separate read-only list type and the handler type updated.

scope.why: Only the model mapping, its types, a focused test and a release note.

maintainability.why: Small, typed, clearly commented change that will follow any future rule change in getScheduledAmount automatically.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Uses getScheduledAmount and the scheduleModel mapper.
